caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender pork slices and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a patterned bowl, the warm lighting highlights the dish against a wooden table.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface details and slight curling edges.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, with visible noodles, green onions, and a dark sheet of nori floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with red and blue geometric patterns and a red rim, smooth surface with slight gloss.
